## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | string |  | No | The text to display on the FAB. When set, the FAB becomes extended. |
| lowered | boolean |  | No | Lowers the FAB's elevation. |
| size | enum |  | No | The size of the FAB. Extended FABs do not have different sizes. |
| touchTarget | enum |  | No | Controls the optional 48x48 touch target wrapper.<br/><br/>Use `touchTarget="none"` with `size="small"` to reduce the touch target. |
| variant | enum |  | No | The FAB color variant to render. |

## Slots

Material Web components frequently use named slots. In React, you can pass `slot="..."` on children (e.g. `<Icon slot="icon" />`).
